title: Playbook Check: CLI Implementation
description: Walk through the CLI changes for playbook check trigger+poll and check history listing

steps.title: Playbook command group router
steps.description: Dispatches 'check' and 'checks' subcommands following the goals/ pattern. Shows help text and uses parseApiError for error handling.

steps.title: cmdPlaybookCheck: trigger + poll loop
steps.description: POST triggers the check, then polls GET every 5 seconds for up to 10 minutes. Terminal states: PASS, FAIL, ERROR. Supports --json output. Exit code 0 for PASS, 1 otherwise.

steps.title: cmdPlaybookChecks: list history
steps.description: GET check history for a rule, displays formatted table with ID, status, compliance rate, and date. Supports --json output.

steps.title: Dispatcher: playbook case
steps.description: Added 'playbook' case to the main command switch statement and updated usage text.
